lawyer: Mr. Mohammad Nowab Ali ------for the Appellant.
full_judgment: 17. The evidence on record clearly shows that there existed a Kabinnama showing marriage between the accused and the second wife in the year 1976. The voter list was also produced in court to show that Kazi Gulshanara was recorded there as the second wife of the accused in the finally published voter list dated 5.8.83. There is a certificate issued from the local primary school showing that the children of the second marriage are reading in that school. An Insurance Policy had also been taken in the year 1978 and the Insurance was taken in the name of Abdur Rahim being minor his guardian had been recorded to be his mother namely Kazi Gulshanara. These documents were recorded long before the dispute arose as to when Gulshanara was married and there is no reason why these documents would not be taken into consideration for a finding that Gulshanara was married to the accused as his second wife long before in the year 1976 which will go to show that the instant case was instituted by the complainant in 1989 after 13 years is an after thought and could easily be explained to have been instituted only to give pressure upon the accused Abdur Rahim as it is admitted that Abdur Rahim has instituted a case against the brother of the first wife very recently.
